const int INF = 1000000000;

struct Edge {
    int to, cap, cost, flow;
    size_t rev;
};

void insertEdge(vector<vector<Edge>>& graph, int from, int to, int capacity, int cost) {
    Edge forward = {to, capacity, cost, 0, graph[to].size()};
    Edge backward = {from, 0, -cost, 0, graph[from].size()};
    graph[from].push_back(forward);
    graph[to].push_back(backward);
}

int main() {
    int N, m, k, c, d;
    scanf("%d %d %d %d %d", &N, &m, &k, &c, &d);
    int totalNodes = N * 101 + 2;
    vector<vector<Edge>> graph(totalNodes);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x;
        scanf("%d", &x);
        x--;
        insertEdge(graph, totalNodes - 2, x * 101, 1, 0);
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 101; i++) {
        insertEdge(graph, i, totalNodes - 1, INF, i * c);
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i < N; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 100; j++) {
            insertEdge(graph, i * 101 + j, i * 101 + j + 1, INF, 0);
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        int u, v;
        scanf("%d %d", &u, &v);
        u--; v--;
        for (int j = 0; j < 100; j++) {
            for (int K = 1; K <= k; K++) {
                int edgeCost = d * (K * K - (K - 1) * (K - 1));
                insertEdge(graph, u * 101 + j, v * 101 + j + 1, 1, edgeCost);
                insertEdge(graph, v * 101 + j, u * 101 + j + 1, 1, edgeCost);
            }
        }
    }
    
    int source = totalNodes - 2;
    int sink = totalNodes - 1;
    int totalFlow = 0, totalCost = 0;
    
    while (totalFlow < k) {
        vector<int> dist(totalNodes, INF);
        vector<int> parent(totalNodes, -1);
        vector<size_t> parentEdgeIndex(totalNodes);
        vector<int> inQueue(totalNodes, 0);
        queue<int> q;
        
        dist[source] = 0;
        q.push(source);
        inQueue[source] = 1;
        
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int node = q.front();
            q.pop();
            inQueue[node] = 0;
            
            for (size_t idx = 0; idx < graph[node].size(); idx++) {
                Edge& e = graph[node][idx];
                if (e.flow < e.cap && dist[node] + e.cost < dist[e.to]) {
                    dist[e.to] = dist[node] + e.cost;
                    parent[e.to] = node;
                    parentEdgeIndex[e.to] = idx;
                    if (!inQueue[e.to]) {
                        q.push(e.to);
                        inQueue[e.to] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (dist[sink] == INF) break;
        
        int augmentFlow = k - totalFlow;
        for (int v = sink; v != source; v = parent[v]) {
            int u = parent[v];
            size_t idx = parentEdgeIndex[v];
            augmentFlow = min(augmentFlow, graph[u][idx].cap - graph[u][idx].flow);
        }
        
        for (int v = sink; v != source; v = parent[v]) {
            int u = parent[v];
            size_t idx = parentEdgeIndex[v];
            size_t revIdx = graph[u][idx].rev;
            graph[u][idx].flow += augmentFlow;
            graph[v][revIdx].flow -= augmentFlow;
            totalCost += graph[u][idx].cost * augmentFlow;
        }
        
        totalFlow += augmentFlow;
    }
    
    assert(totalFlow == k);
    printf("%d\n", totalCost);
    return 0;
}
